title: Short-context Vector Micro-market Scout: pricing sensitivity & fallback playbook
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Objective: rapidly synthesize competitive signals and buyer economics for short-context vector retrieval (<=512 tokens) across niche micro-markets (legal briefs, clinical notes summarization, marketing snippets). Deliver a prioritized opportunity heatmap, per-region pricing sensitivity matrix, and an operational fallback playbook for model supply shocks.

Why this matters: our Dedicated and Private customers increasingly run short-context retrieval pipelines where token cost is dominated by embedding calls and RAG orchestration. Emerging model variants (compact embed models, quantized decoders) offer different latency/cost tradeoffs by region. Product needs a defensible playbook for when a primary model or region becomes constrained and for packaging short-context offerings to APAC/EMEA buyers.

Scope: competitive landscape scan (open and hosted embedding + small decoder variants), synthetic workload bench (latency, cost per query, cold/hot prefix patterns), buyer interviews (5 enterprise buyers across legal/health/marketing verticals), and a runbook that maps supply signals to product actions (routing, quantization fallback, reserved capacity triggers).
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap with top 8 micro-markets and scoring across latency, cost-per-query, and model-compatibility
Region-specific pricing elasticity table (US, EU, APAC) for three embedding+decoder pairings
Operational fallback playbook with clear triggers and 3 tested fallback paths (model variant, region redirect, cached-kv strategy)
A short repo of synthetic benchmark scripts and ingestable results (CSV links in artifacts)
Stakeholder signoff from Eng (runtime), PM lead, and Solutions Eng
tasks: Define micro-market taxonomy and prioritization criteria (owner: PM)
Inventory candidate models and variants (open-source embeds, hosted embeddings, compact decoders) (owner: Research)
Run synthetic benchmark for 3 workloads per micro-market with regional endpoints (owner: Eng SRE)
Conduct 5 buyer interviews and synthesize pricing sensitivity notes (owner: PM)
Draft fallback runbook and run tabletop with runtime team (owner: PM + Eng)
Prepare short internal playbook and handover doc for Sales/SEs (owner: PM)
Publish artifact links to Confluence and link to product roadmap epics
